name: @nivalis/string-similarity
description: Finds degree of similarity between strings, based on Dice's Coefficient, which is mostly better than Levenshtein distance.
author: Akash Kurdekar <npm@kurdekar.com>

scripts.smoke: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');for(const t of [p.types,p.exports['.'].types]){if(!t||!fs.existsSync(t)){console.error('missing types file: '+t);process.exit(1)}}import(p.name).then(m=>{if(typeof m.compareTwoStrings!=='function'){console.error('compareTwoStrings not exported');process.exit(1)}console.log('smoke ok')}).catch(e=>{console.error(e.code||e.message);process.exit(1)})"
